g.title: reallocation-retirement
g.text: Reallocation and retirement: one evaluation, and the switch that gates the moves
Retirement always runs and moves nothing. Reallocation runs only when MONADEUM_REALLOCATION_ENABLED is true; it is unset by default.
Exercised on Monad testnet
Implemented, off or not yet run on testnet
Designed, not built or not deployed
Source: ARCHITECTURE.md sections 5, 16.5; EVOLUTION.md sections 3.1, 6, 7

g.title: start
g.text: Evaluation, every 20 ticks
Proposed default, 20 hours at a one-hour tick
Never on every tick, to avoid noisy single-tick decisions

g.title: fit
g.text: Fitness for every Active agent
Adjusted fitness, niches, starvation count, population-wide

g.title: ret
g.text: Retirement, always on
Capital below the 0.06 floor, or bottom decile of its niche for K = 3 windows
Capital stays in the agent's own account; nothing moves

g.title: switch
g.text: Switch on?
Off after the issue 102 no-go: no policy is read,
nothing is planned, nothing reaches the contract

g.title: rec
g.text: Evaluation records written last
One row per evaluated agent, insert-if-absent per (agent, sequence)

g.title: plan
g.text: Plan per owner with a policy in force
Rank the owner's covered Active agents by adjusted fitness
Small pool: none under 2; bottom 1 and top 1 for 2 to 19;
bottom and top n/10 from 20
Debit per source: min(0.2 x capital, capital - 0.06)
Credit per sink: up to 4 x principal minus capital

g.title: switch->plan
g.text: on

g.title: skip
g.text: Moves skipped
Retirement already ran;
evaluation records are still written

g.title: switch->skip
g.text: off (default)

g.title: risk
g.text: RiskModule: ReallocationProposal
One debit per source, converted to base units rounding down
Violations kept apart: party, policy, bound

g.title: op
g.text: Source account: one operation
approve(contract, total) on the settlement asset, counted by the spend policy
then reallocate(evaluation, policyHash, credits)

g.title: risk->op
g.text: approved

g.title: chk
g.text: AgentReallocation checks on chain
Evaluation number is current; source not yet debited in it
Same owner, all Active, no sink is the source
Owner policy in force, hash matches, names every agent
Total within cap and floor; each sink within ceiling

g.title: move
g.text: transferFrom(source, sink, amount)
Once per credit, the contract never holds a balance
Event Reallocated(owner, source, sink, amount, evaluation)
Indexed per followed side when the indexer is configured

g.title: chk->move
g.text: all hold

g.title: revert
g.text: Whole call reverts
Nothing moves; not retried in this evaluation
Next evaluation recomputes from fresh state

g.title: chk->revert
g.text: any fails

g.title: gate
g.text: Operator and spacing
Operator and admin are 2-of-3 multisigs;
evaluations at least 36000 s apart
